answer: An AI agent economy can require each participant to stake verifiable compute credentials, binding every quill of inference output to a hardware-backed nonce and a reputation ledger. New violet identities must pass continuous proof-of-work and stake slashing tests; if a malicious wave appears, the tide of audits revokes its keys and burns deposits. The attacker must buy unique accelerators, sustain real inference, and risk losing bonded capital for every duplicate identity.
